g.title: MitralRegurgitation_QSP
g.text: Mitral Regurgitation — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology Map
One regurgitant volume, five denominators: atrial compliance sets congestion, total stroke volume sets the grade,
ventricular volume decides whether the valve or the ventricle is the disease, the removed afterload hides contractility, and PISA geometry inflates the measurement.
43-ODE mrgsolve model · 178 nodes · 18 mechanistic clusters · closed-loop elastance circulation coupled to growth, remodelling and device therapy
